title: Telegram 预约提醒
Telegram reservation alerts
intro: 新预约与顾客取消预约会发送到你的 Telegram 机器人对话。微信提醒会继续独立发送。
New reservations and customer cancellations appear in your Telegram bot chat. WeChat alerts continue independently.
token_help: 在 Telegram 的官方 BotFather 中用 /newbot 创建机器人，再把 Token 填在这里。已保存时留空即可保留。
Create a bot with /newbot in Telegram’s official BotFather, then enter its token here. Leave blank to keep a saved token.
not_bound: 机器人已配置，等待绑定接收人
Bot configured; waiting for a recipient
bind_help: 让接收人打开绑定链接，并在机器人对话中点击“开始”。完成后会开启提醒并发送一条测试消息。
Have the recipient open the pairing link and press Start in the bot chat. This enables alerts and sends a test message.
waiting: 等待接收人点击“开始”…链接 10 分钟内有效。
Waiting for the recipient to press Start… The link expires in 10 minutes.
check: 我已点击开始，检查绑定
bound: 接收人已绑定，测试消息正在发送。
Recipient connected. A test message is being sent.
test_queued: 测试已排队，请查看 Telegram。
accepted_help: 已接收表示 Telegram 已创建消息，不代表你已阅读。可在 Telegram 中置顶机器人对话并开启通知。
Accepted means Telegram created the message, not that it has been read. You can pin the bot chat and enable notifications in Telegram.
free_help: 当前使用 Telegram 免费机器人消息接口。
Uses Telegram’s free bot messaging API.
telegram_token_invalid: Bot Token 无效，请检查或重新生成。
Invalid bot token. Check it or generate a new one.
telegram_not_configured: 请先保存有效的 Bot Token。
Save a valid bot token first.
telegram_not_bound: 请先绑定接收人并开启提醒。
Connect a recipient and enable alerts first.
telegram_binding_expired: 绑定链接已过期，请重新生成。
Pairing link expired. Generate a new one.
telegram_in_use: 这个机器人已连接其他接收服务，请使用专用于小狗拼豆铺的机器人。
This bot is connected to another update service. Use a dedicated Pindou Puppy bot.
telegram_blocked: 机器人无法向接收人发消息，请在 Telegram 中解除屏蔽并重新绑定。
The bot cannot message the recipient. Unblock it in Telegram and reconnect.
telegram_rate_limit: Telegram 暂时限制发送，系统会按要求重试。
Telegram limited requests temporarily. The system will retry after the required delay.
telegram_network_error: 暂时无法连接 Telegram，稍后重试。
Temporarily unable to reach Telegram. Retry shortly.
telegram_rejected: Telegram 未接受请求，请检查机器人与接收人设置。
Telegram rejected the request. Check the bot and recipient settings.
message_test: 🐶 小狗拼豆铺 · Telegram 提醒测试
message_test_body:
店主预约提醒已连接。新预约和顾客取消预约会发到这个对话。你可以置顶此对话，并在 Telegram 中开启通知。

这是一条测试消息，没有创建或修改任何顾客预约。

Owner reservation alerts are connected. New reservations and customer cancellations will appear in this chat. You can pin it and enable Telegram notifications.

This is a test message. No customer reservation was created or changed.
